reason: Test the low-risk active-loop schedules first. Grouping FMOPA operations by reused B vector is the most direct reuse hypothesis; moving loop control between independent tile updates is another small change. A guarded next-B prefetch is easy to bound, though prior inactive-path prefetch results do not predict this path. The two packed-B proposals describe essentially the same layout, so test one before the other and avoid treating them as independent evidence. Padding has unverified cache benefits and adds scratch use. Transpose fusion repeats A reads across panels, while A transpose fusion targets fallback sizes and does not affect the fixed n=512 timing.
